newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian March castor firm, export interest low.
newsitem.headline: Indian March castor firm, export interest low.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices rose on Tuesday to 1,144/1,145 rupees from 1,137/1,138 rupees despite low export interest, dealers said.
Prices gained as bull operators remained active buyers on reports of lower than expected new crop arrivals in southern India, they said.
Groundnut oil slid to 350 rupees per 10 kg from 352/353 rupees on higher new crop arrivals of about 140/150 tonnes coupled with limited physical buying.
In Rajkot spot oil rose to 535/540 rupees per 15 kg from 530 rupees on renewed purchases by state agencies, one dealer said.
